<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram name="增量合并" id="openspec-delta-merge"> <mxGraphModel dx="-544" dy="-114" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="826" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#1e293b;" value="归档时,增量规格合并进主规格" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="420" x="360" y="16" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="deltaBox" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dbeafe;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=8;" value="change 增量规格
changes/当前变更/" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="280" width="300" x="60" y="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="add" parent="deltaBox" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="ADDED	新增一条行为(WHEN/THEN)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="260" x="20" y="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="mod" parent="deltaBox" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="MODIFIED	给已有行为加场景" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="260" x="20" y="130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="del" parent="deltaBox" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="REMOVED	废弃一条行为" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="260" x="20" y="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="deltaHint" parent="deltaBox" style="text;html=1;fontSize=12;fontColor=#64748b;" value="只声明本次改了什么" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="260" x="20" y="248" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="mainBox" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=8;" value="主规格(能力宪法)
specs/当前能力/spec.md" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="280" width="320" x="660" y="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="merged" parent="mainBox" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dbeafe;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="合并后的完整行为集" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="240" x="40" y="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="kept" parent="mainBox" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="未提及的场景原样保留" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="240" x="40" y="130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="history" parent="mainBox" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="历史变更逐轮沉淀" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="240" x="40" y="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="mergeEdge" edge="1" parent="1" source="deltaBox" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#2563eb;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=12;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="mainBox" value="归档时智能合并
只动声明过的部分"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
